cases.sentence: Нечестивец бежит, хотя никто его не ___.
cases.translation: The wicked flee when no one pursues.
cases.explain: The verb преследует (pursues) requires a nominative subject, though here it's expressed as a verb form.

cases.sentence: А праведник смел, как ___, когда в стране беззакония.
cases.translation: The righteous is bold as a lion.
cases.explain: Лев is a predicate nominative after the comparison 'как' (as), requiring nominative case.

cases.translation: He who keeps the law is a wise son.
cases.explain: Закон is the direct object of the transitive verb хранит (keeps), taking the accusative case.

cases.translation: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked.
cases.explain: Закон is the direct object of the transitive verb забывают (forsake), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Бедный человек, притесняющий ___, точно дождь с проливной.
cases.translation: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain.
cases.explain: Бедняков is the direct object of the transitive verb притесняющий (oppressing), taking the accusative case (plural).

cases.sentence: Злодеи не понимают справедливости, а те, кто ищет ___, понимают ее.
cases.translation: Evil men don't understand justice; but those who seek the Lord understand it fully.
cases.explain: Господа is the direct object of the transitive verb ищут (seek), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Точно ревущий лев или рыщущий медведь — злой ___ над бедным людям.
cases.translation: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
cases.explain: Правитель is the predicate nominative in the comparison 'точно...', requiring nominative case.

cases.translation: One who works his land will have an abundance of food.
cases.explain: Землю is the direct object of the transitive verb возделывает (works), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: Нечестивец бежит, хотя никто его не преследует.
reading.question: Why does the wicked person flee according to this verse?
options: Out of fear, even though no one pursues
Because he is running to escape punishment
reading.correct: Out of fear, even though no one pursues
reading.explain: The text states: Нечестивец бежит, хотя никто его не преследует — the wicked flee even when no one pursues them.

reading.ru: А праведник смел, как лев, когда в стране беззакония у нее много правителей.
reading.question: What two contrasting situations are compared?
options: The righteous are bold and many rulers
A country in rebellion has many rulers, but the righteous is bold as a lion
Lions are bold and rebels are fearful
Many rulers make the righteous afraid
reading.correct: A country in rebellion has many rulers, but the righteous is bold as a lion
reading.explain: The text contrasts: праведник смел, как лев (the righteous is bold as a lion) with в стране беззакония у нее много правителей (in a lawless country there are many rulers).

reading.ru: Лучше бедняк, чей путь беспорочен, чем богач, чьи пути бесчестны.
reading.question: What is more important than wealth according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text states: Лучше бедняк, чей путь беспорочен (Better is the poor who walks in his integrity) than a rich man with dishonest ways.

reading.ru: Скрывающий свои грехи не преуспеет, а признающий и оставляющий их найдет милость.
reading.question: What happens to those who hide their sins versus those who confess them?
options: Those who hide prosper, those who confess fail
Both hide and confess equally succeed
Those who hide don't prosper, but those who confess find mercy
reading.correct: Those who hide don't prosper, but those who confess find mercy
reading.explain: The text contrasts: Скрывающий свои грехи не преуспеет (He who conceals his sins doesn't prosper) with признающий и оставляющий их найдет милость (whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy).

reading.ru: Верный человек будет богат благословениями, а спешащий разбогатеть не останется безнаказанным.
reading.question: What is the reward for a faithful person and the consequence for one eager to be rich?
options: A faithful man is rich with blessings, but one eager to be rich will be punished
reading.correct: A faithful man is rich with blessings, but one eager to be rich will be punished
reading.explain: The text states: Верный человек будет богат благословениями (A faithful man is rich with blessings), а спешащий разбогатеть не останется безнаказанным (one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished).

reading.ru: Упрекающий человека найдет потом больше приязни, чем тот, чей язык льстив.
reading.question: Who finds more favor - one who rebukes or one who flatters?
options: The one who rebukes finds more favor
reading.correct: The one who rebukes finds more favor
reading.explain: The text states: Упрекающий человека найдет потом больше приязни, чем тот, чей язык льстив (One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters).
